name: turned_bushing_is_not_a_hole
why: ENTRY GT12, the fallback of the blind hole, and a defect found by looking for it (26/9/2026). A bushing made by revolution: Ø30 30 long, with the axial blind hole Ø8 10 deep. Before, drawing_dimension took the Ø30 OUTLINE for a hole («Ø30 ↧30», callout on callout) and in the side views tried to call out the two circles seen edge-on. A hole looks at whoever reads AND is an inner ring of a planar face (the criterion of the centre marks); the outline of a round part has a diameter dimension. The depth of the blind hole is also read from the geometry (the cylinder and its bottom) and must say what the callout says.
defect_caught: The outline of a round part called out as a blind hole as deep as the part; a blind hole whose depth read from the geometry does not match the callout; a view of only edge-on circles that answers «no dimension was born» without saying why.
_the_views_are_called_by_uid: V1 front and V2 from above (the bushing from the side: two edge-on circles), V3 side (the bushing from the front, from the hole side: two circles).

expect.tolerance_why: pi inside: pi x 15^2 x 30 minus pi x 4^2 x 10

expect.why: a view attaches to the FILE of the part
there is only one hole: the Ø8
the callout carries the depth of the blind hole
the same depth read from the cylinder and its bottom: it must match the callout
the bottom is the outer ring of a planar face
the outline has its own diameter dimension, re-read — not a hole callout
the two dimensions of the view
before, the two callouts were born at the same point, one on top of the other

steps._how_it_was_before: Up to 0.126.0 this view was refused («the only edges are circles seen edge-on»). From 0.127.0 (entry GT14) the longitudinal view of a round part is dimensioned.

expect.why: the length of the bushing, between the two faces seen edge-on, re-read
the Ø30 is already dimensioned in the front view: only once in the whole drawing
